item.description: Penn State picked up a transfer commitment from an intraconference rival on Tuesday evening. item.description: Sitting winless in Big Ten play, Penn State welcomed its toughest foe yet to the Bryce Jordan Center on Tuesday night — No. 2 Michigan. item.title: Drum Tao Returns to Penn State with ‘The Best’ Synchronized Percussion Show
item.description: Direct from Japan, big-drum percussion ensemble Drum Tao returns to North America with an all-new show, “The Best,” at 7:30 p.m. Tuesday, Jan. 27, in Penn State's Eisenhower Auditorium. Tickets are $52 for adults, $14 for University Park students and $19 for individuals 18 and younger and are available over the phone at 814-863-0255 in person from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. weekdays at Eisenhower Auditorium or online. item.title: State High RB D’Antae Sheffey Commits to Penn State
item.description: Penn State has added a local prospect to its 2026 recruiting class. Three-star running back D'Antae Sheffey has committed to the Nittany Lions, he announced on social media Wednesday night. He's a current senior at State College Area High School, where he totaled 234 carries for 1,613 yards and 24 touchdowns this past season, all career bests. item.title: Moshannon Valley Economic Development Partnership Names Josiah Jones Executive Director
item.description: The Moshannon Valley Economic Development Partnership has named Josiah Jones as its new executive director, the Philipsburg-based nonprofit organization announced this week.
